newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy energy watchdog to get final OK next week.
newsitem.headline: Italy energy watchdog to get final OK next week.

text.p: The Senate (upper house) industry committee will meet next Tuesday to approve the members of a regulatory watchdog for the electricity and gas sectors which must be in place before the privatisation of electricity group Enel set for spring 1997, parliamentary sources said.

The industrial production committee of the lower Chamber of Deputies approved the nomination of Pippo Ranci as the authority chairman on Wednesday. The other members are Giuseppe Ammassari and Sergio Garribba.
The body requires the Senate's final approval before it becomes operational.

Legislation creating the watchdog for the electricity sector was passed at the end of last year ahead of a hoped-for privatisation of Enel this spring. The flotation was delayed while Italy went through a government crisis.
